# Ryan Phelan, The Strongbow Group

> Ryan Phelan is a go-to-market advisor to B2B technology companies. He helps leadership teams close the Clarity Gap, the distance between how a company understands itself and how its market experiences it, through two disciplines: Go-to-Market Alignment (inside the company) and Go-to-Market Translation (outside it). The Strongbow Group LLC is the practice. Site: https://ryanphelan.com.

## Key concepts
- The Clarity Gap: what opens when a company can no longer tell one story about itself, and starts telling that story to itself instead of to its customer. It opens from two directions, internal misalignment across teams, and failure to translate the story to the market.
- Go-to-Market Alignment (inside): getting leadership, product, marketing, sales, customer success, and AI to reinforce one market position, via a six-part method (Market Definition, Market Need, Brand Definition, Strategic Positioning, Organizational Alignment, Market Execution).
- Go-to-Market Translation (outside): deconstructing a company's go-to-market and rebuilding it into a message and customer relationship the market actually understands and values.

## About Ryan Phelan
- 28 years across every side of B2B technology: vendor, client, agency, operator, CEO, and board.
- CEO of RPE Origin (2021–2026). 2023 ANA Thought Leader of the Year. Former Chairman, Email Experience Council. 50+ columns for MarTech.
- Selected work: Sherwin-Williams, TJ Maxx, Synchrony Financial, HP, FedEx, Capital One, Microsoft, Wells Fargo, Allstate, Sam's Club, lululemon.
